summary.text: Nathan Brewer is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican incumbent Bryan Logan.
He was also the Democratic nominee in the May 13, 2025 special general election for the same seat, which Logan won.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Brewer was born in Arlington, Texas, graduated from Arlington High School, and lists his career experience as a businessman.
In the 2025 special election, Brewer received 29.7 percent of the vote to Logan's 61.6 percent; independent Steve Sanford received 8.7 percent.

In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, Brewer said his campaign priorities were stricter laws to protect communities, making mental health care more available in rural areas, and making schools stricter and safer, and he named public safety, education and mental health as committee interests.
